title: Voxi Monitor TUI Actions
description: Single-key hotkeys the `voxi monitor -w` TUI reads from raw-mode /dev/tty, and the labels/box titles displayed for each.

actions.description: Map of action id to its keys, category, and display labels. Action ids are referenced directly by internal/monitor's key dispatcher.

title.description: Full label shown after the bracketed hotkey in a box header, e.g. 'hardware load'.

short.description: Short lowercase word shown after the bracketed hotkey in the footer badge row, e.g. 'hardware'.

items.description: A single printable character, or one of the control-key tokens <c-c> (Ctrl-C) / <esc> (Escape).

keys.description: All raw bytes that trigger this action. keys[0] is the canonical letter shown in box headers and footer badges.

category.description: 'monitor' toggles one of the resource boxes; 'system' controls the TUI itself (show-all, quit).
